why_agent_cannot: identity verification is required and cannot be performed by an agent
what_human_must_do: Check that you're 18 or older and not in an excluded place (see below).
Open app.vangrid.io and choose Capture Data. If you prefer the Android app, use the Google Play listing linked from vangrid.io.
Connect a wallet: "Your wallet is your sign in."

Get an access code. "You need one to upload captures. You do not need one to browse bounties." The app says codes are shared in Vangrid's Discord. Warning Don't buy or swap codes: "Sharing, selling, or farming codes results in immediate account termination and forfeiture of accumulated PTC."
Allow camera access, plus location if a bounty needs it. Walk slowly around the subject and cover every side.
Open data.vangrid.io , read a bounty and check that its place is legal for you to film. Submit your clip before the deadline.
Complete the payment profile. The board says: "We need your email to contact you, and a CEX account with completed KYC so we can pay rewards."
If your clip is accepted, wait for Vangrid to pay you by hand.
costs: Filming is free: "You pay nothing to submit. Reconstruction is covered by the bounty." The docs say contributors deal with "no gas". Your reward gets trimmed, though: "With current defaults, a $50 reward pays $5 to the platform, $5 for reconstruction, and $40 to the contributor."
